tasks.prompt: Build a simple electric circuit in order
tasks.explanation: Current runs from the battery along the wire through the switch to the lamp. Break the loop anywhere and the lamp goes out.

tasks.prompt: What a seed needs in order to sprout
tasks.explanation: A seed needs soil, water and light. Miss any one of the three and nothing sprouts — these are conditions, not a wish list.

tasks.prompt: Set up apparatus to separate sand from water
slots: What to pour the mix into
tasks.explanation: A filter in the funnel lets water through and holds the sand back. They separate by particle size, not by weight.
